purpose: 用独立保存的检查点复核旧格式归档，观察 0xFF、0xFE、替换字符及历史策略版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 3 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["�", "\xfe", "\xff"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["�", "\xfe", "\xff"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 同一较早决策、同一检查点；后续策略列表内容损坏时应整份失败并保留真实错误输出。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-damaged.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 3 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
review: archive validation failed: darksafe: invalid audit range: record 3 fingerprint mismatch
exit status 1
